{{Quote|He who wields the blade will be able to control my brother.|The Daughter|<ref name="Altar of Mortis (episode)">{{TCW|Altar of Mortis (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Dagger of Mortis''', also known as the '''Mortis Dagger''' and '''Force-imbued dagger''', was a blade that was kept in the underground [[Altar of Mortis/Legends|Altar of Mortis]]. It was capable of killing [[The Ones/Legends|the Ones]]; namely the [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]], [[Son/Legends|Son]], [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]], and [[Abeloth|Mother/Abeloth]].

==History==
[[File:KenobiMortisDagger-AOM.png|thumb|left|220px|The dagger materializes in Obi-Wan Kenobi's hand]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] attempted to use the Dagger of [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Son, but when the Son stole it and tried to kill the Father with it, the Daughter sacrificed herself to protect her [[Parent/Legends|father]]. The Father placed it with the Daughter's body in [[Daughter's grave/Legends|her tomb]], but the dagger was stolen by the Son shortly thereafter. Rather than have the Son murder him with it, the Father took it from him and stabbed himself with the blade, mortally injuring himself and severing the Son's powers, allowing him to be killed by Skywalker.

After the death of [[Abeloth]], the former Mother, in [[44 ABY]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sent ten [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] out to search for the [[Mortis monolith/Legends|Mortis monolith]] so that they could recover the Dagger. The Jedi wanted the Dagger as insurance against the return of Abeloth. The Son and the Daughter were the ones who had defeated Abeloth every time she had escaped before, and since the Dagger could kill the Ones, Luke believed it could also kill Abeloth—who had drunk from the [[Font of Power]] like the Son and bathed in the [[Pool of Knowledge]] like the Daughter. It is unknown whether the Dagger was created on Mortis, or the Ones' original [[Abeloth's planet|home planet]].
